purpose: Non-admission discovery of original US wildfire event observations with complementary mapped fire severity and harmonized incident-point records; no source acquisition, reuse rights, CAT scientific approval or loss-model admission.

entries.name: USGS/USFS Monitoring Trends in Burn Severity (MTBS) current Burn Severity Portal products
entries.provider: US Geological Survey / USDA Forest Service (MTBS)
entries.spatial_scope: United States including CONUS, Alaska, Hawaii and Puerto Rico; only fires exceeding region-specific mapping thresholds and suitable imagery
entries.temporal_scope: 1984-2026 selectable in live portal as of 2026-11-03; recent fire seasons may be incomplete, releases revise historical pixels
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Fire-level mapped boundaries and points in vector national products; burn-severity raster mosaics and per-fire mapping products; specific pixel size and projection vary by product
entries.note: Original USGS/USFS product; MTBS includes some prescribed fires and primarily large fires (generally >=1000 acres West or >=500 acres East), not a census of all ignitions or burned buildings. In 2026 the Burn Severity Portal reprocessed historical Landsat products and some pixel severity, projection and area measurements may change; freeze download UTC, product, region, fire identifier, vintage, CRS, severity classes, nodata, pixel lineage and original SHA-256. Not statistically independent of FPA FOD when linked via MTBS_ID, or of USFS/NIFC reporting. Burn severity is not building damage or insured loss. Do not automatically fetch or redistribute bytes before specific access/rights and scientific review.

entries.name: US Forest Service FPA FOD Seventh Edition spatial wildfire occurrence dataset (FPA_FOD_20260615)
entries.provider: USDA Forest Service Research Data Archive / Karen C. Short
entries.spatial_scope: United States and included reported territories, with variable reporting completeness across agencies and time
entries.temporal_scope: Wildfire discovery years 1992-2024; Seventh Edition released 2026-08-04, file edition FPA_FOD_20260615
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Approximately 2.66 million harmonized incident-point records, reported final fire area, event dates, causes and cross-system keys; downloadable ACCDB, GDB, GPKG or SQLite (SpatiaLite) publication
entries.note: The seventh edition is not a perimeter or burn-severity raster and is not a complete national wildfire census; only minimum precision at PLSS section (approximately one square mile) is required for reported points. USFS standardizes mixed agency records and deduplicates where possible; investigate reporting changes, duplicate incidents, source agencies and spatial uncertainty. Fields include MTBS_ID and ICS_209_PLUS_INCIDENT_JOIN_ID for bounded identity crosswalk, but linking does not prove independent observations. The live EDW ArcGIS MapServer is labelled current edition and may change without a URL change; pin the archive edition, original file, hash, event date and variable dictionary. No claims, insured amounts or building losses; no automated data acquisition, reuse or CAT admission approved by this candidate.
